craft_notes: Sthāyin: the prasiddhi heart — gold, child, recognition. Sanskrit-first: brahma-hanana-tanniṣedha-vat + āśrama-bheda-vat kept both comparisons; satyaṃ rajataṃ paśyāmi kept verbatim (the gold-silver speech-act IS the argument); bālasya kept child (seeing-not-inferring); adṛṣṭa-vaidehya…kaivalya-phaladā + śivasamānatvaphaladā + aikyaparyavasāyinī kept the three-fruits roll; hṛdayaparyavasāyinīm kept the heart-close. Rows: 9 (gold/silver; three-fruits), 2 (long compounds spilling), 1 ('ending in the heart' closes — hṛdaya end-weight, the soteriology lands in the body), 12 declined — the argument's roll carries. Close: 'ending in the heart.' Rejected: paraphrasing the goldsmith example away — killed: prasiddhi IS the example; smoothing the child's absence-of-inference — killed: the negation is the epistemology; resolving the three-fruits into one — killed: anekavidhā kept severally.

lines: somewhere unqualified: same, like the ashrama-distinction;
from meaning-conjunction in what is said and beyond.
In eternality even, the scriptures' recognition:
the recognition is scripture, through goldsmith-recognition.
from those two's absence, in youth
its presence is powerless. But rooting recognition,
he — let him be — for someone, some work:
she severally many-kinded: thus in a world
filled with many recognitions, whoever to-be,
he such recognition by force assumes,
l4.sanskrit_cite: brahmahananatanniṣedhavat saṃskārabhedaḥ saṃskārātiśayaḥ tadabhāve kvacit anadhikṛtatvam iti samānam āśramabhedavat phalotkarṣāc ca utkarṣaḥ tatraiva upaniṣadbhāgavat bhinnakartṛkatve 'pi sarvasarvajñakṛtatvam atra saṃbhāvyate taduktatadatiriktayuktārthayogāt nityatve 'pi āgamānāṃ prasiddhiḥ tāvat avaśyopagamyā anvayavyatirekādhyakṣādīnāṃ tatprāmāṇyasya tanmūlatvāt satyaṃ rajataṃ paśyāmi iti hi sauvarṇikādiparaprasiddhyaiva prasiddhir eva āgamaḥ sā kācit dṛṣṭaphalā bubhukṣito bhuṅkte iti bālasya prasiddhita eva tatra tatra pravṛttiḥ nānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadā tayoḥ abhāvāt yauvanāvasthāyāṃ tadbhāvo 'pi akiṃcitkaraḥ prasiddhiṃ tu mūlīkṛtya so 'stu kasmaicit kāryāya kācit adṛṣṭavaidehyaprakṛtilayapuruṣakaivalyaphaladā kācit śivasamānatvaphaladā kācit aikyaparyavasāyinī sā ca pratyekam anekavidhā ity evaṃ bahutaraprasiddhipūrṇe jagati yo yādṛśo bhaviṣyan sa tādṛśīm eva prasiddhiṃ balād eva hṛdayaparyavasāyinīm abhimanyate

reads_against.argmap: How is āgama's prasiddhi rooted? → Āgama's authority is prasiddhi-based (gold-silver by goldsmiths, child by seeing): recognition, not inference, roots it; and its fruits range severally to the heart's close.
c1_essence: Āgama's prasiddhi is recognition-rooted — gold seen through goldsmiths, child through seeing — its fruits ranging severally to the heart's close.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
